projects.title: Lemon Disease Detection
paragraphs: The Lemon Leaf Disease Detection is a web application that uses a fine-tuned YOLO model to detect diseases in lemon leaves. The application is built using Next.js and utilizes the Roboflow platform for model training and deployment. The dataset used for training the model is sourced from Kaggle, ensuring high-quality data for accurate disease detection.

The application allows users to upload images of lemon leaves and receive real-time predictions on whether the leaves are healthy or affected by diseases. The fine-tuned YOLO model ensures high accuracy in detecting various diseases, making it a valuable tool for farmers and agricultural professionals.
projects.summary: The Lemon Leaf Disease Detection is a web application that uses a fine-tuned YOLO model to detect diseases in lemon leaves. The application is built using Next.js and utilizes the Roboflow platform for model training and deployment. The dataset used for training the model is sourced from Kaggle, ensuring high-quality data for accurate disease detection.

projects.title: IICT-SUST
paragraphs: IICT-SUST is a comprehensive web application designed to facilitate the management of student information, course details, and faculty data for the Institute of Information and Communication Technology (IICT) at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology (SUST). The application features a user-friendly interface that allows students to register, view their courses, and access faculty information. Faculty members can manage their profiles and courses efficiently. The backend is powered by NodeJS with PostgreSQL as the database, ensuring robust data handling and security. The application also integrates Nodemailer for email notifications and Cloudinary for image storage.
